svg.title: B.U.T.L.E.R system overview
svg.desc: Block diagram of the Butler home assistant: people talk or type to Butler; a voice worker turns speech into text; the main agent decides what to do with help from a local language model and tool servers; an awareness backend keeps track of the house and speaks up on its own; devices are reached over MQTT or the home network.
